claim_boundary: Corrected equation-led T-MOEA reconstruction on same-author public Nysted assets. It is not the unavailable original T-MOEA candidate set, cable transition/router, control set, seed, reference front, or reported-result reproduction.

historical_v1_guard.guard_protocol: seed 20260729, 3000 complete-layout physical FES; remove only requested_workers, observed_workers, and timing_seconds; canonical JSON uses sorted keys and compact separators
historical_v1_guard.label_correction: The earlier M2 label is superseded for new work because several transition choices are engineering declarations. The historical row remains for compatibility; v2 is explicitly M3.

paper_preserved_controls.wake: paper Eqs. (2)-(3): alpha=0.5/ln(H/0.0002), fixed 2/3 deficit, root-sum-square superposition, and 8760-hour AEP
paper_preserved_controls.selection: NSGA-II nondominated rank and crowding distance
paper_preserved_controls.topology_mutation: symmetrized k-nearest-neighbor isolation score followed by centroid-directed relocation
paper_preserved_controls.equation_16: the relocation candidate belongs to the complement of the entire pre-mutation layout
paper_preserved_controls.random_swap: swap two chromosome positions with probability pm

declared_reconstruction_controls.duplicate_repair: retain first occurrence in chromosome order and counter-keyed uniformly refill free candidate indices
declared_reconstruction_controls.parent_selection: two binary rank/crowding tournaments per offspring
declared_reconstruction_controls.parent_equality_resolution: if the two selected parent indices are equal, replace the second with (second+1) modulo population size
declared_reconstruction_controls.knn_adjacency: undirected union of directed five-nearest-neighbor arcs
declared_reconstruction_controls.randomness: counter-keyed events independent of worker scheduling
declared_reconstruction_controls.partial_terminal_generation: evaluate exactly min(30, remaining physical FES) offspring and select back to 30

exact_physical_work.unit: one complete layout evaluation of T-MOEA AEP and declared cable cost
exact_physical_work.reported_3000_fes: 30 initial layouts plus 99 complete offspring generations

cpu_execution.default_workers: 0 means all hardware threads visible through std::thread::hardware_concurrency
parallel_stages: offspring parent selection, crossover, repair, topology mutation, and swap
